---
title: "HEI analysis"
format: html
---

**Overall hypothesis**: The ora microbiome modifies health outcomes given by a diet
pattern.

**Microbiome hypothesis**: Worse eating habits affect oral microbiome, maybe nitrate or acid
producing bacteria. Worse eating habits are:

  - Lower Healthy Eating Index (HEI)
  - Higher Ultraprocessed foods index (NOVA)

```{r setup}
library(SummarizedExperiment)
confounders <- c("age", "sex", "NHANES_year")

load("NHANES_oral_microbiome.se")
```

```{r}
metadata.df <- data.frame(colData(NHANES_oral_microbiome.se))
alpha_indices <- grepv("alpha_", colnames(metadata.df))
diet_indices <- c("HEI2020_ALL", "nova1_kcal")
```
